## Qompanies
- [Angel**Q**](https://angelquantum.com/) 🇸🇬 - Algorithming qubits efficiently. 🧙 ⟩
- [A**Q**T](https://www.aqt.eu/) 🇦🇹 - Building QPUs with ions. 💤 ⟩
- [Classi**Q**](https://www.classiq.io/) 🇮🇱 - Programming QPUs. 💱 ⟩
- [Dira**Q**](https://www.diraq.com/) 🇦🇺 - Building QPUs with cold silicon. 🧑‍🔬 ⟩ 💱 ⟩ 🐨 ⟩
- [Ele**Q**tron](https://eleqtron.com/) 🇩🇪 - Building QPUs with ions. ⚛️ ⟩ 💱 ⟩
- [Infle**Q**tion](https://infleqtion.com/) 🇺🇸 - Building quantum stuff with atoms. 🚀 ⟩
- [Ion**Q**](https://www.ionq.com/) 🇺🇸 - Building QPUs with ions. 🗿 ⟩
- [I**Q**M](https://iqm.tech/) 🇫🇮 - Building QPUs with cold electrons. 🧠 ⟩
- [Pas**Q**al](https://www.pasqal.com/) 🇫🇷 - Building QPUs with atoms. 🧑‍🔬 ⟩ 💱 ⟩
- [Plan**Q**C](https://planqc.eu) 🇩🇪 - Building QPUs with (different) atoms. 🧑‍🔬 ⟩
- [Psi**Q**uantum](https://www.psiquantum.com/) 🇺🇸 - Building QPUs with photons. 💤 ⟩ ⚛️ ⟩
- [**Q**-CTRL](https://q-ctrl.com/) 🇦🇺 - Programming QPUs. 🗿 ⟩ 🐨 ⟩
- [**Q**Perfect](https://www.qperfect.io/) 🇫🇷 - Programming QPUs. 🚀 ⟩
- [**Q**raken **Q**uantum](https://www.qraken-quantum.com) 🇦🇹 - Linking quantum stuff with photons. 🐈 ⟩ 💞 ⟩ 💤 ⟩
- [**Q**sensato](https://qsensato.com/) 🇮🇹 - Sensing stuff with atoms. 🗿 ⟩
- [**Q**uandela](https://www.quandela.com) 🇫🇷 - Building QPUs with photons. 🧑‍🔬 ⟩
- [**Q**uEra](https://www.quera.com/) 🇺🇸 - Building QPUs with atoms. 🚀 ⟩
- [**Q**unnect](https://www.qunnect.inc/) 🇺🇸 - Linking quantum stuff. 🗣️ ⟩
- [**Q**uobly](https://www.quobly.io/) 🇫🇷 - Building QPUs with cold silicon. 🧠 ⟩
- [**Q**uokka **Q**uantum](https://www.quokkacomputing.com/) 🇦🇺 - Selling QPUs moqups. 🐈 ⟩ 💤 ⟩ 🐨 ⟩ 💞 ⟩
- [Vi**Q**thor](https://viqthor.com/) 🇫🇷 - Dealing with MW photons. 🧑 ⟩
